sentences.text:
Appellant
 Through: Mr.Sunder Prakash Jain, Adv.
 versus
 Master Manoj Through His Father & Anr.

.....  Respondents  Through:
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE REKHA PALLI  ORDER % 17.02.2023 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
CM APPL. 7941/2023 (delay 38 days) & CM APPL. 7942/2023 (delay 30 days (RF))
3. These are applications preferred by the appellant seeking condonation of 38 days' delay in filing the appeal and 30 days' delay in re-filing the appeal.
4. The applications are, for reasons stated therein, allowed and the delay of 38 days' in filing the appeal and 30 days' in re-filing the appeal is condoned.
6. The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks to assail the award dated 30.07.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.

7. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned Tribunal has not only granted a highly exorbitant amount towards compensation, but has also erred in rejecting the appellant's prayer for grant of recovery rights against the owner and the driver of the offending vehicle.
Oriental Ins. Co. Ltd vs Master Manoj Through His Father & Anr on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133222324/
1 8.

entities.text: Oriental Ins. Co. Ltd vs Master Manoj Through His Father & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that an appeal assailing the award pertaining to the same accident is already under challenge before this Court by way of MAC.APP.83/2023 and is next listed on 12.09.2023.
Furthermore this Court has, subject to the appellant depositing 75% of the awarded amount, stayed the operation of the impugned award during the pendency of the aforesaid appeal.
9. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.

CM APPL. 7940/2023 (stay)
11.This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

12.The application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit 75% of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal within a period of six weeks, with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of the respondent as per the disbursal scheme contained in the impugned award.
13.Subject to the appellant depositing the amount in terms of this order, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal REKHA PALLI, J FEBRUARY 17, 2023 kk Oriental Ins. Co. Ltd vs Master Manoj Through His Father & Anr on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133222324/
